featured_reviews.name: Prem B Chhabria
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the most shocking, frustrating, and downright unacceptable experiences I’ve ever had with a car service center — and this is coming from someone who has interacted with multiple brands and workshops over the years. Puneet Motors is, without question, the worst of them all.

I had handed over my Tata Tiago EV for a minor accident repair and second free service. What followed was two full weeks of silence, zero updates, repeated follow-ups, false promises, and sheer negligence. After multiple reminders, I finally got the vehicle back — and it was nothing short of a disgrace:
•	The car was returned in a filthy, unwashed condition.
•	Interior panels were dusty, the seats were stained, and no basic cleaning was done.
•	The dashboard was misaligned, and despite repeatedly pointing it out, it was never fixed.
•	The windscreen washer fluid was contaminated, leaving a greasy film, and even that wasn’t taken care of.
•	The engine bay was caked in dust, as if the car had been parked under a shed for weeks and simply pushed out without lifting the bonnet.

I raised a complaint directly with Tata Motors, and after all the hue and cry, the car was picked up again with promises from the Service Manager and Body Shop in-charge that the issues would be fully rectified.

What happened next? A repeat of the same pathetic cycle. The car came back a second time in almost exactly the same miserable state — dirty from the outside, dashboard untouched, interior sloppy, and all the issues ignored yet again.

The worst part? The people in charge — the ones who are supposed to be managing customer care — showed an attitude of total indifference. The Service Manager was unreachable, failed to respond to multiple calls and WhatsApp messages, and clearly lacked both competence and accountability. At no point did anyone take genuine ownership of the situation.

This is not a Tata-authorized service experience. This is third-rate, careless, and unworthy of the brand. I’ve now formally requested Tata Motors to permanently transfer my service registration away from Puneet Motors, and I will never take my car back there — not even for an emergency.

If you’re a Tata owner in Mumbai and value your vehicle, your peace of mind, and your time — do not go to Puneet Motors. They have proven to be entirely unreliable, disorganized, and incapable of delivering even the most basic level of service.

A service center is meant to restore your car. Puneet Motors managed to ruin the experience — twice.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Subject
7th Escalation – Repeated Battery Failure, Mental Harassment & Demand for Immediate Refund – Kia Sonet MH01 FB 4161
Dear Sir / Madam,
This is my 7th escalation email regarding the extremely serious and unresolved issue with my Kia Sonet (MH01 FB 4161).
Today once again my car has completely failed to start, even though I had driven the vehicle last night and parked it properly in my parking area. This evening, when I had to step out urgently with my family, the vehicle again refused to start, leaving me completely stranded.
This is now the 6th or 7th time that my vehicle has faced the same repeated battery failure issue, which is absolutely unacceptable for a new car purchased only a few months ago.
Previously, when the same issue occurred, my vehicle remained at the service center for almost 5 days. During that time, the service team informed me that the battery test report was normal. As per your team’s assumption that the accessories might be causing battery drainage, I agreed to remove all the accessories installed in the vehicle so that the issue could be resolved.
However, despite testing the vehicle and removing the accessories, the battery was not replaced, and now the same problem has occurred again today.
Because of this recurring issue, I am facing continuous inconvenience, mental stress, and extreme frustration. Today being Saturday, I had important personal commitments and family plans, but due to this defective vehicle I was left completely helpless.
I also tried calling Mr. Kshitij Pandav, the sales executive from Kia Prabhadevi who sold me this vehicle, but his phone was not reachable. This type of behaviour after selling the vehicle is highly irresponsible and unprofessional. At the time of purchase, the sales team was extremely proactive in convincing me to buy the car and add accessories, but now when the customer is facing a serious problem, no one is taking accountability.
Frankly speaking, I am now mentally exhausted and extremely disappointed with the entire experience. I purchased this vehicle with complete trust in the Kia brand, but my experience so far has been stressful, inconvenient, and unacceptable.
At this stage, I strongly suspect that the vehicle sold to me may not have been in proper condition, because it is completely unreasonable that a new car repeatedly fails to start within such a short period of ownership.
Due to the repeated breakdowns, lack of proper support, and the mental harassment caused, I am now formally demanding a full refund of the vehicle purchase amount, as I no longer wish to continue with this vehicle.
If this matter is not resolved immediately, I will be forced to take further action, including:
• Filing a formal complaint with the Consumer Court
• Lodging a complaint with the appropriate legal authorities regarding the sale of a defective vehicle
• Escalating the matter to consumer protection platforms and regulatory authorities
Please treat this matter with extreme urgency. I expect an immediate response and a clear resolution regarding the refund process.
I sincerely hope Kia India understands the seriousness of this situation and resolves the matter without forcing me to pursue legal action.
Regards,
Mithun Dhuru

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Sir / Madam,

This is my sixth email regarding the repeated issues faced with my newly purchased Kia Sonet. While there have been verbal discussions, I have not received any proper written response so far, which is extremely disappointing.

The recurring issues have been ongoing since November, from the date of purchase of my new vehicle. The continuous breakdowns and repeated battery failures have caused significant inconvenience and mental stress. This situation is now seriously affecting my peace of mind, as I purchased a new car expecting reliability and safety.

Recently, I was informed by the service team that both the accessory screens (2 Nos.) and the ambience light installed in my vehicle have been removed and sent back to Kia Showroom Prabhadevi. I have been assured that I will receive a full refund of the entire amount paid for these accessories (not a single rupee less).

Additionally, I have been verbally informed and committed by Kia India that in case any further major issue occurs in my vehicle in the future, the showroom will refund the full car purchase amount (not a single rupee less) that I paid at the time of purchase. I request written confirmation of this commitment at the earliest.

While I acknowledge these assurances, I must formally express my serious concerns regarding the following:

Repeated battery failure in a brand-new vehicle.

Installation of accessories that resulted in continuous technical problems. I was not informed by Kshitij Pandav that installing these accessories could lead to battery drainage or related issues. Instead, I was strongly encouraged to install additional accessories without proper disclosure of potential risks.

Extremely poor customer support and absence of written communication.

Unprofessional conduct and lack of responsiveness from the concerned Sales Executive.

Despite multiple emails, I have not received even a single proper written response. This raises serious concerns regarding customer service standards and escalation handling processes.

Further, I wish to formally lodge a complaint against Mr. Kshitij Pandav. He has not responded to emails nor to messages in the WhatsApp group created by the service center. There has been a clear lack of accountability and professional support from his side.

At the time of purchase, I was strongly encouraged to install additional accessories without being properly informed about possible consequences such as battery drainage or technical complications. It is the responsibility of a sales representative to transparently guide customers regarding:

Suitability of accessories

Possible risks involved

Long-term impact on vehicle performance

Unfortunately, this responsibility was not fulfilled.

I therefore request:

Written confirmation of the full refund process for the removed accessories.

Written documentation of the commitment regarding full vehicle refund in case of any future major issue.

A formal internal review of the conduct of the concerned Sales Executive.

Immediate improvement in communication and escalation management.

This entire experience has been extremely stressful and disappointing for me as a customer who invested in your brand with complete trust. I expect an urgent and formal written response to this email.

featured_reviews.name: Amish Chheda
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience purchasing the VinFast VF6 from the VinFast South Mumbai Showroom was extremely disappointing and stressful.

Initially, when I visited the showroom and saw the car, I was impressed by the design and finishing. I believed VinFast was a reputed international brand and expected professional service. Unfortunately, the actual experience after booking and delivery was completely opposite.

One of the biggest issues was during the PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Initially, they were not even ready to allow proper PDI. After repeated arguments and follow-ups, they finally allowed it, but with unnecessary restrictions. They did not allow a professional PDI expert, and they also restricted entry to only one person. Such behavior creates doubt and reduces customer confidence. A customer spending such a huge amount should have full transparency during inspection.

The dealer staff were not responsive, avoided answering questions properly, and did not seem to care about customer satisfaction. They initially forced me to take insurance only from them and were not willing to allow my own insurance. After repeated discussions, they finally agreed.

The accessories experience was also misleading. I only wanted floor mats and trunk mats separately, and the salesperson clearly said it would be possible. But after delivery, they changed their statement and started forcing me to buy the complete accessories kit at a high price with many unnecessary items.

Even the FASTag commitment was misleading. They promised full balance amount in the FASTag, but deductions were already made before handover. It may not be a huge amount, but such behavior creates distrust.

Another major disappointment is the real-world driving range. At the time of selling, they spoke about getting around 380–400 km range, but the actual experience is very different.

Even the delivery experience was poor. When I first saw the display car, the finishing and presentation looked excellent, but at the time of delivery my car had dust and lacked proper finishing checks.

I also sent multiple complaint emails to the company, but there was no proper response or satisfactory resolution. Since this is the only dealer in Mumbai, I thought purchasing locally would provide better support and convenience. Unfortunately, my experience proved otherwise.

I request future buyers to be extremely careful before purchasing from this dealer. Please take every promise in writing. Personally, after my experience, I would advise people to think many times before buying this car or dealing with this showroom.

This is not just poor planning and unprofessional behavour but also it’s complete disregard for a customer’s time and effort. Wasting 2–3 hours for a confirmed appointment that was denied by the sales team mate and her hierarchy.
This is unacceptable from a reputed dealership.
If basic communication and respect for bookings cannot be maintained, it seriously questions the credibility of the entire sales process and after sales services.
Expected much better from this branch. Hope the management looks into this and trains the staff on basic courtesy and accountability.
Strongly advise other buyers to double-confirm everything multiple times before visiting this showroom.
